description: This file defines the PerformanceTrackerDecorator class, which acts as a decorator for the PerformanceTracker entity, providing additional methods for setting related Employee data and formatting date fields. It leverages traits for ORM entity management and date/time handling.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that wraps a PerformanceTracker entity, providing utility methods for setting employee relationships and formatting date fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a PerformanceTracker entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the PerformanceTracker using an employee number.

methods.name: setAddedByByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee who added the PerformanceTracker entry, based on employee number.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the added date of the PerformanceTracker, formatted as a string.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the modified date of the PerformanceTracker, formatted as a string.
